item.title: MindSuite
item.author: emecas
item.description:
MindSuite
4.1.2
Smart agent language
MINDsuite has been successfully applied in numerous fields, including defense, pharmaceuticals, insurance, finance, nuclear decommissioning, healthcare, and network performance. The platform allows for the integration of smart agents, constraint programming, fuzzy logic, neural networks, business rules, case-based reasoning, and genetic algorithms, and it provides a simulation tool and an interpreter for the programming languages.

Issue #193 in emecas/commitit, open, opened on 2025-08-23.
